summary: scripts/st-test gives each run its own TMPDIR, TMP and TEMP on disk (/var/tmp/st-test.XXXXXXXX, or in ST_TEST_TMP) and removes it when the run ends (--keep keeps it). Every `nix develop -c` a check ran left its nix-shell.* directory, and whatever its tests wrote, in the caller's TMPDIR, which on one build host is a RAM-backed /tmp; evidence-wrap's key file was left there too. A killed run's directory is removed by the next run (by flock)

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes. What a note covers and how the gate judges it are unchanged; TMPDIR is not an input of any check.

compatibility.detail: Runs re-execute main's st-test, so this applies to every run once on main. scripts/ci-local and scripts/ci-local-web keep their own TMPDIR.

manual.detail: None. The nix-shell.* directories earlier runs left in /tmp stay until removed by hand.
